newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen struggling in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen struggling in range trading.

text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to continue a narrow-range consolidation on Thursday with investors sidelined in an absence of positive news to boost recent weak sentiment, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the weighted index closed 26.14 points or 0.33 percent higher at 8,022.89. Turnover was T$67 billion.

"The market is directionless. Investors cannot convince themselves to chase higher prices even though the market has seen solid downside support at 7,800 points," said Chen Han-chung, an analyst of Yungli Securities.
Brokers said the steel sector may rebound.
Taiwan's largest steelmaker, China Steel Corp, said on Wednesday it was raising third-quarter product prices by T$400 to T$600 per tonne, or about 3.4 to 3.6 percent.
The price increase is expected to significantly boost China Steel's profit, brokers said.
The movement of high-technology shares would also be a focus.
Initial resistance is seen at 8,150 points.
